host_threads.policy: Pin OMP/MKL to six allocated CPUs for this repeated timing run.
host_threads.comparison_scope: Keep prior unpinned 1k smoke diagnostic; use consistently pinned threads for repeated cost curves.
host_threads.causal_claim: This operational pin is not established as a fix for previous startup slowness.

stability.summary: All three repetitions and their first-use spread remain. Median/min/max are descriptive technical-repeat summaries, not confidence intervals.

semantics.ordinary_tps: Synchronized native loop rates include eviction/output processing; scheduling/reset/verification outside the loop remain excluded.
semantics.selection_compaction: Whole instrumented prefix-plus-continuation replay totals, nested in inference; not per-token rates or costs to add again.
semantics.warmup: Unchanged source312 standard synthetic warmup; no additional per-shape warmup. First repetition is not guaranteed cold because preceding work and persistent caches can prime execution.
semantics.memory: Prefill occupancy uses 2048 logical cached tokens; decode occupancy uses 2112. Reserved pool and total VRAM remain distinct.
semantics.comparability: This 64-decode/three-repeat version is separate from 8-decode feasibility and old unpinned 1k smoke.

interpretation: Full/R-KV/AgentKV ordinary decode rates differ by at most 0.35 percent across all three repeats. This is a measured stability observation for one history and node.

StreamingLLM first ordinary repeats are slower; later two agree within 0.54 percent. The first ordinary pass takes about 0.92/1.72/2.00 seconds longer than its instrumented replay at 80/50/25 percent. First-use overhead is plausible; no compiler or kernel cause was established.
All first repetitions remain in the medians/ranges and raw artifacts. No instrumented rate replaces ordinary throughput.
These are timing measurements, not model accuracy, task-success or recovery-quality results. Single logical length does not establish a length trend.
